purpose: Non-scoring connectivity and Harbor adapter smoke; no formal benchmark result.

claude_code_boyue_trial.reason: Harbor Claude Code adapter installs curl/bash/nodejs/npm/procps at runtime; the minimal canary image stalled at apt-get update and was cancelled.

credentialed_trial.model_request: repeated TLS connection errors from Daytona sandbox to Boyue endpoint
credentialed_trial.artifact_effect: answer.txt absent because harness could not receive a model response

daytona.blocker: The Daytona sandbox can be created and the adapter runs, but its egress cannot establish a TLS connection to api.boyuerichdata.opensphereai.com. This is a network allowlist/egress issue, not a harness or credential issue.

conclusion: Boyue model API, Harbor local lifecycle, and the frozen harness-v0 adapter are reachable end to end in local Docker; the one-trial verifier passed. A credentialed Daytona sandbox can be created, but the current Daytona tier blocks outbound model traffic and rejects sandbox-level allowlist overrides. A relay on 38.47.121.235 and a Cloudflare Quick Tunnel were both verified independently, but neither received Daytona chat traffic. Do not count the Daytona reward-zero trials as benchmark results; formal execution requires a Daytona plan with provider-supported public egress or a different execution tier.
